## Purpose / scope

Describe the prompt, template, or policy change and who should use it.

## Compatibility / behavioral impact

What changes for agents consuming the prompt? Are prior agent instructions superseded?

## Validation

- [ ] Markdown renders correctly.
- [ ] Paths and links resolve.
- [ ] Instructions have a clear completion condition and distinguish fact from speculation.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or sensitive production identifiers.
- [ ] Example is readable by at least one agent without implicit context.

## Evidence / limitations

List files checked, tests or manual reviews performed, and any known limitations.
